Add mark-dispatching before the spawn and mark-dispatched after the fix commit, and add re-dispatch after escalate, in the DSL view and in 6.4.1. Owner: architecture-agent.
why_this_severity: The Ledger Entry Lifecycle and StoryWorkflow show the missing edges, and the Ledger refuses a wrong transition and names it, so an implementer reaches the right sequence (no to fails_purpose); a reader of 6.4 must compare it with the state machine to find the gap (raises_cost).
